# Simulation_Data_Provenance

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The documented origin and generation process of all data used in simulations, including whether it comes from real measurements or synthetic generation. Enables reproducibility and trust in TCC/iNEST research by making it possible to audit whether results derive from genuine biological or topological sources.
